issues.description: Script uses XMLHttpRequest to fetch YouTube player base.js and possibly interacts with proxy servers for unlocking age-restricted videos. The proxy servers are third-party and may receive video IDs and possibly other metadata.
issues.location: ACCOUNT_PROXY_SERVER_HOST and VIDEO_PROXY_SERVER_HOST variables; XMLHttpRequest usage in getSignatureTimestamp()
issues.recommendation: Ensure proxy servers are trusted and review their privacy policy. Avoid sending unnecessary user data.

issues.description: No evidence of privacy collection such as reading cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, clipboard, or keylogging.
issues.recommendation: Maintain current practice; do not add privacy-invasive features.

issues.description: Script uses eval() to inject itself into the main window context for compatibility with Greasemonkey sandbox restrictions.
issues.recommendation: Avoid using eval() where possible. If necessary for compatibility, ensure injected code is strictly controlled and not influenced by external input.

issues.description: No evidence of code obfuscation, minification, or base64/unicode string encoding.
No DOM XSS risk detected. User input and URL parameters are not directly inserted into innerHTML/outerHTML or document.write().
issues.recommendation: Continue to sanitize any future user input before DOM insertion.

issues.description: No excessive or unused permissions. @grant none is used.
No sensitive API calls (geolocation, RTCPeerConnection, MediaDevices, Clipboard API, Notification API) detected.
issues.recommendation: Avoid adding sensitive API calls unless strictly necessary.

issues.description: Proxy servers are hardcoded and not official YouTube endpoints. Supply chain risk exists if these proxies are compromised.
issues.recommendation: Allow users to configure their own trusted proxy or use official endpoints where possible.

issues.description: No clickjacking or iframe manipulation detected.

summary: The script is generally transparent and does not collect privacy-sensitive data or abuse permissions. However, it relies on third-party proxy servers for bypassing YouTube age restrictions, which introduces a critical data transmission risk and a medium supply chain risk. The use of eval() for sandbox bypass is a high risk but is controlled. No evidence of DOM XSS, code obfuscation, or sensitive API abuse. Users should be aware of the risks associated with proxy server usage.
